verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs give an official container image and a docker run command (localai/localai:latest), so the core of running the runtime in a container is directly supported. PRELOAD_MODELS supports declarative model setup at startup. The reproducibility side is thin, though: the only documented example uses the floating :latest tag. Missing for 10: documented pinned or versioned image tags for reproducible deploys, compose/Kubernetes deployment guidance, GPU-specific container variants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
